covers: JSE opening session on Thursday 19 November 2026, up to about 09:50 SAST, ahead of the SARB rate decision
headline: Pick n Pay jumps 7.1% and Investec falls 3.4% on results day; the JSE edges up and the rand firms to R17.27/$ before SARB
summary: The JSE All Share was at 106,768.8 early on Thursday, up 0.2% from Wednesday's 106,571.7 close, and the rand had firmed to R17.27 per dollar from R17.35 earlier in the morning, ahead of today's SARB decision with the repo rate at 7.25% (LRC Market Dashboard, 19 Nov 2026 09:48 SAST). Pick n Pay rose 7.1% to R26.60 and Investec Ltd fell 3.4% to R128.96 on its interim results day (JSE quotes 09:32 SAST). Gold was at $3,733 and platinum at $1,369, slightly above Wednesday's closes; US markets have not yet opened, so Wednesday's mixed close (S&P 500 -0.2%, Nasdaq +0.4%) is the latest US read.

items.title: Pick n Pay +7.1% to R26.60 in early trade; rating unchanged
items.summary: Pick n Pay traded at R26.60 at 09:32 SAST on 19 Nov 2026, up 7.1% on the day (LRC Stock Scanner quotes). We could not yet confirm a company announcement behind the move, so treat it as unexplained for now. The LRC Stock Scanner rates Pick n Pay BUY (score 66, valuation 'fair value'); the rating is unchanged. Its last results (26 weeks to 30 Aug 2026, published 26 Oct 2026) showed a headline loss of 40.71c per share, narrower than 59.77c a year earlier.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026 09:32 SAST; Pick n Pay SENS 26 Oct 2026

items.title: S&P 500 -0.2% at 7,323.63; Nasdaq +0.4% at 24,429.89
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed Wednesday at 7,323.63 against Tuesday's 7,340.53 (-0.2%), and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,429.89 against 24,328.38 (+0.4%). Both are about 3% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27). Big single-share moves at the close included Palo Alto Networks +9.9%, UnitedHealth -10.2%, Take-Two +6.2% and Broadcom +3.6%.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance) daily closes, 18 Nov 2026, published 05:59 SAST 19 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), US close 18 Nov 2026 (23:00 SAST)

items.title: JSE All Share +0.2% early, after Wednesday's 3.7% fall
items.summary: The All Share was at 106,768.8 and the Top 40 at 98,848.07 early on Thursday 19 Nov 2026, against Wednesday closes of 106,571.7 and 98,732.67 (LRC Market Dashboard, 09:48 SAST). Gold miners were firmer, with AngloGold Ashanti up 2.1% at 09:32 SAST.

items.title: SARB rate decision today; repo rate at 7.25%
items.summary: The SARB Monetary Policy Committee announces its decision on Thursday 19 November. The repo rate has been 7.25% since September's 25bp hike. October CPI, released on Wednesday, was 5.2% (September 4.5%).
items.source: SARB MPC dates page via LRC Market Dashboard; Stats SA October 2026 CPI, 18 Nov 2026

items.title: Investec Ltd -3.4% and Investec plc -3.1% on interim results day; ratings unchanged
items.summary: Investec Ltd traded at R128.96 (-3.4%) and Investec plc at R131.67 (-3.1%) at 09:32 SAST on 19 Nov 2026, the day of its results for the six months to 30 Sep 2026 (LRC Stock Scanner; LRC JSE results calendar). Both are rated HOLD by the LRC Stock Scanner (scores 67 and 62, valuation 'undervalued'); ratings unchanged. We will add the reported figures once we have read the announcement.
